## Summary

Describe the change and the problem it solves.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactoring
- [ ] Security or dependency update

## Testing

- [ ] Backend tests pass (`uv run pytest`)
- [ ] Ruff checks pass (`uv run ruff check .`)
- [ ] Ruff formatting check passes (`uv run ruff format --check .`)
- [ ] Frontend build passes, if applicable (`cd frontend && npm run build`)

## Security and privacy

- [ ] No secrets or private user data were added.
- [ ] Input validation and error handling were considered.
- [ ] Documentation was updated where needed.

## Additional context

Add screenshots, related issues, or migration notes if relevant.
